title: Penal Code — Book One - Chapter 1: General Principles and Definitions — Article 12
text: For the purposes of this law, the following persons are considered officials of public services: 1. Permanent and contract employees of the State and state enterprises; 2. Permanent and contract employees of public institutions; 3. Members of the organs of State and provincial and local assemblies; 4. Attorneys-at-law, arbiters, experts, witnesses and other persons whose certifications are honored.
